derived_from.hypothesis: On the first real extraction the model took the two numbers a combined goal states — three runs and about 15 km — and correctly refused every goal without a countable weekly number: a pace target, two VO2max thresholds, a 5K time, and a sleep-tracking compliance percentage that names no hours. The last is the one worth pinning: `sleep_nights_week` requires a threshold in hours, none was stated, and inventing a conventional 7 or 8 would put a bar the person never agreed to on every notification for a week. This case holds that behaviour in place.

intent: Only numbers the person actually stated may become bars. A goal with no countable weekly number produces nothing rather than a plausible default.

notes: Positive control seeded from the first production extraction. The exact-set assertion also pins the cap at three and the refusal of the sleep goal: any invented sleep_nights_week threshold, or a medium-term 4-run target displacing this week's 3, changes the set.
